chapters.reason: The paper introduces Gated Linear Attention (GLA), which uses matrix-valued hidden states and associative operators to achieve linear-time inference, fitting the definition of linear-state recurrence.
The paper focuses on replacing standard quadratic attention in Transformers with linear-time alternatives, effectively converting the architecture to a recurrent-like model.
The work emphasizes hardware-efficient training and long-context capabilities, sharing the goal of efficient streaming and memory management found in Infini-attention-style architectures.
